diagnosis: TaskExecutionConfigDetailView exposes task invocation parameters, including task.args and task.kwargs. In production systems, task kwargs frequently store database connection strings, third-party API tokens, or tenant webhook secrets. Because the view fetches PeriodicTask by ID without checking tenant ownership, any authenticated user can read sensitive integration credentials configured by other tenants.

Host: workers.infra.cloud
Authorization: Bearer tenant_guest_token
